chat_history.content:
The factorial of a number \( n \) is the product of all positive integers less than or equal to \( n \). It is denoted as \( n! \).

For \( 5! \):
\[ 5! = 5 \times 4 \times 3 \times 2 \times 1 = 120 \]

So, the factorial of 5 is 120.
